original: ファラ達は本当に仲がいいんだな
traducao: You guys are really close, Farah.

original: うん
traducao: Yeah.

original: やっぱり、幼馴染みだからね
traducao: After all, we're childhood friends.

original: まあ、仲がいいかどうかはさておき、\n世間一般的にはそう呼ばれる間柄だな
traducao: Setting aside whether we're close,\nthat's what society usually calls it.

original: そうか。\nまあ、一口に幼馴染みと言っても\n色々な関係があるだろうからな
traducao: I see.\nThough saying childhood friends covers\nall sorts of different relationships.

original: ガイは？\nそういう人はいないの？
traducao: What about you, Guy?\nDon't you have anyone like that?

original: 俺か？　\nそうだな、俺は……
traducao: Me?\nLet's see, I suppose I...

original: お。　噂をすれば、だ。\nおーい！
traducao: Oh, speak of the devil.\nHeeey!

original: ガイか。\nどうした、何か用でも？
traducao: Guy.\nWhat is it? Did you need something?

original: いや、特別用事はないんだけどさ。\nちょうど、お前の話が出たから、ついな
traducao: Nah, nothing in particular.\nYou just happened to come up in talk.

original: 私の話？
traducao: Talk about me?

original: それは珍しい
traducao: That is rather unusual.

original: ねえ……もしかしてこの人が……？
traducao: Hey... could this person be...?

original: まさか……。\nさすがにそれはないだろ？\nどう見たって、ガイよりかなり年上だぞ
traducao: No way...\nSurely that's impossible.\nHe looks way older than Guy!

original: 何か？
traducao: Is something the matter?

original: いいえ、何でも！
traducao: No, nothing at all!

original: ご要望をいただいていた\n新しいシーツをお持ちしました
traducao: I have brought the new sheets\nyou requested earlier.

original: ロックスか。\n入ってくれ
traducao: Rocks, is that you?\nCome on in.

original: 失礼します
traducao: Pardon me.

original: こちらがルーク様の、\nこちらが他の皆様のシーツです
traducao: Here are the sheets for Master Luke,\nand these are for everyone else.

original: ……うん、確かに
traducao: ...Yeah, looks good.

original: すまないな。\nルークのわがままに付き合わせて
traducao: Sorry about making you cater\nto Luke's selfishness.

original: いいえ。\nルーク様は王族ですから、シーツの材質に\nこだわりを持たれるのは当然です
traducao: Not at all.\nMaster Luke is royalty, so of course\nhe is particular about fabric.

original: むしろこちらの配慮が\n行き届かず、すみません
traducao: Rather, I apologize for my lack\nof foresight.

original: いや、十分よくやってくれていると思うよ。\n同じ使用人として頭が下がるくらいだ
traducao: No, you do a wonderful job.\nAs a fellow servant, I respect you.

original: そんな……。\n僕の方こそ、\nガイ様の事、すごいと思ってます
traducao: Not at all...\nI am the one who thinks so\nhighly of you, Master Guy.

original: ルーク様の事を、本当に大切に\n思ってらっしゃるのが、\nお仕えしている様子から伝わって来ます
traducao: I can clearly see how deeply\nyou care for Master Luke just by\nthe way you serve him.

original: よしてくれ。\n聞いててかゆくなってくる
traducao: Give me a break.\nHearing that makes me itch.

original: 同じ使用人のよしみだ。\n困った事があったら言ってくれ。\n多少は力になれると思うぜ
traducao: We're fellow servants.\nIf you ever have trouble, tell me.\nI can lend a hand.

original: 余りものの材料で、\nいかに美味い料理を作るか、とかな
traducao: Like making tasty food\nfrom leftover ingredients.

original: いいですね。\nぜひ、一度ご教授願いたいです
traducao: That sounds wonderful.\nI would love to learn from you.

original: だから、そんな事言っても\n無理なものは無理だって
traducao: Look, even if you ask for that,\nimpossible is impossible.

original: んだよ、ガイ！\n俺の言う事が聞けねぇのか？
traducao: What gives, Guy?!\nCan't you listen to what I say?!

original: 穏やかじゃないね。\n一体、どうしたというんだい？
traducao: This sounds rather heated.\nWhatever is the matter?

original: いやー、\nルークのいつものわがままだよ
traducao: Nah,\nit's just Luke's usual selfishness.

original: どこがわがままっつーんだよ！
traducao: What about this is selfish?!

original: 俺専用のデッカイ風呂を作れって\n言っただけだろうが！
traducao: I just told him to build me\na huge private bath of my own!

original: だから、それがわがままだって……
traducao: That's exactly what makes it selfish...

original: そんなにデカイ風呂に入りたきゃ、\n海にでも飛び込みゃいいんじゃねぇか？
traducao: If you want a huge bath that badly,\nwhy don't you dive into the ocean?

original: 一面大海原なんて\n豪勢で魅力的な露天風呂だろ。\nルークお坊ちゃまにぴったりだな
traducao: The vast open sea makes a luxurious\nopen-air bath, don't you think?\nFits you perfectly, young master.

original: んだと、こら！\nバカにしてんじゃねぇ！
traducao: What did you say, you punk?!\nStop making fun of me!

original: へぇ〜。\nバカにされてるのはわかるのに、\n自分のわがままはわからねぇんだな
traducao: Heh~. So you can tell when you're\nbeing mocked, but you can't see\nyour own selfishness, huh?

original: おいおい、二人ともやめないか
traducao: Hey now, both of you, knock it off.

original: ユーリ！\nこの方は王位継承者なんだぞ。\n無礼な振る舞いは、慎むべきだ
traducao: Yuri!\nHe is an heir to the throne.\nYou must refrain from rudeness!

original: へいへい。\nすんませんでした、と
traducao: Yeah, yeah.\nMy deepest apologies, then.

original: そう堅苦しく捉えないでくれ。\nそんなに難しい話をしてるわけじゃない
traducao: Don't take it so stiffly, please.\nIt's really not that serious.

original: ユーリは、ルークの自覚を促す為に\nあえてああ言ってくれたんだろうし
traducao: Yuri only said that intentionally to\nmake Luke aware of his behavior.

original: ルークだって、\nあんなわがままが通るなんて\n本気で思っちゃいないだろう？
traducao: And Luke didn't seriously think\nsuch a selfish request would\nactually pass, right?

original: ……ふん！
traducao: ...Hmph!

original: お互い……
traducao: Looks like both of us...

original: 苦労するね……
traducao: have our hands full...

original: なぁ、リタって\n航空力学の分野にも強いのか？
traducao: Say, Rita, are you knowledgeable\nin aerodynamics too?

original: 強いって、どのレベルの話？\nそこら辺の科学者よりは、十分詳しいわよ
traducao: What level are we talking about?\nI know far more than basic scientists.

original: 俺さ、今、考えてる事があってさ。\nこう、何とか個人用の\n飛行機とか作れないかなって
traducao: There's something on my mind.\nI've been wondering if we could\nbuild a personal aircraft.

original: ほら、それがあれば\n自由にどこでも行けるだろ？
traducao: See, with that, you could fly\nanywhere you wanted, right?

original: 鳥と同じ気分で、空を飛べるなんて\n最高じゃないか？
traducao: Flying like a bird through the sky...\nWouldn't that be amazing?!

original: 人ひとりぐらいなら\nいけるとは思うわよ
traducao: For just a single person,\nI think it's definitely feasible.

original: 要は、揚力さえ確保出来れば\n浮くわけだし
traducao: In short, as long as you can\nsecure enough lift, it'll float.

original: 浮く事が出来ればかぁ。\nそうすると、やっぱり\nスピードも欲しいよな
traducao: If it can float, huh?\nIn that case, we'd definitely\nwant some speed too.

original: スピードだったら、\n物体と流体の相対速度が重要よ
traducao: For speed, relative velocity between\nthe object and fluid is crucial.

original: 揚力係数が剥離しちゃったら、\n失速しちゃうからね
traducao: If the lift coefficient separates,\nthe craft will end up stalling.

original: でもさ、失速しても\nパラシュートとかあれば、\n落ちても死ぬ事はないよな？
traducao: Even if it stalls, if it has\na parachute, you wouldn't die\nfrom falling, right?

original: そうね、空気抵抗が必要なだけだから。\nでも、高度差が重要だから\n高い位置でないと意味ないわ
traducao: True, you just need air resistance.\nHowever, altitude difference matters,\nso it must be from high up.

original: と言う事はだ、\n高く速く飛べる個人用飛行機に\nパラシュートを積めば安全って事か！
traducao: Which means, if a personal craft\nflies high and fast with a chute,\nthen it's completely safe!

original: うわー、夢が広がるなぁ、おい！\nリタ、一緒に作らないか？　\nやろうぜ！
traducao: Whoa, the possibilities are endless!\nRita, won't you build it with me?\nLet's do it!

original: ガイも結構\nおかしなヤツだと思ってたけど……
traducao: I always knew Guy was kind of a nut,\nbut...

original: なかなかどうして。\nリタもガイに負けず劣らずの\n偏執狂ですからね
traducao: Quite so.\nRita is every bit as much of an\nobsessive fanatic as Guy, you see.

original: ある意味、一緒って事か
traducao: So they're two of a kind, in a sense.

original: （うそ……！\n　お手洗い、全部使用中……？）
traducao: (No way...! Are all the restrooms)\n(completely occupied...?!)

original: （どうしよう……どうしよう？）
traducao: (What should I do... what should I do?)

original: （あ……男の人用のは\n　空いてるみたい……？）
traducao: (Ah... the men's restroom)\n(looks like it's empty...?)

original: （も……もうっ。\n　わたしったら何を考えてるの？\n　ダメよ、そんなの……！）
traducao: (N-No, what am I thinking?! )\n(I can't possibly do something)\n(like that...!)

original: （でも……このままじゃ……。\n　どう……しよう……？）
traducao: (But... at this rate...)\n(what... am I going to do...?)
(...I'm... going to...)

original: おっ、アニーじゃないか
traducao: Oh, if it isn't Annie.

original: どうした？　\nそんな所で。\n何か困ってるのか
traducao: What's wrong?\nStanding in a place like this...\nAre you in trouble?

original: い、いえ、その……！\n何でもありません……っ
traducao: N-No, um...!\nIt's nothing at all...!

original: ほんとにどうしたんだ？\nあんなに焦って……
traducao: What was that really about?\nShe was in such a panic...

original: ふぅ……。\nこれが終わったら、皆さんの\nお布団を干して……
traducao: *phew*... Once this is finished,\nI will hang everyone's futons\nout to air...

original: その後は買い物と……そうだ、\nそろそろ備品リストも\nチェックしておかないと……
traducao: After that is shopping, and...\noh right, I must check the supplies\ninventory list soon...

original: お、今日も頑張ってるみたいだな
traducao: Working hard today as well, I see.

original: どうだ。\nかなり忙しいのか？
traducao: How goes it?\nKeeping quite busy?

original: ガイ様
traducao: Master Guy.

original: ええ……今日もまだまだやる事が\nたくさんあって……
traducao: Yes... I still have so much\nleft to do today...

original: だろうな。\n何せこの船の雑用を\n一手に引き受けてるんだ
traducao: I figured.\nAfter all, you handle every chore\naboard this ship on your own.

original: そうだ。\n何か俺にも手伝える事はないか？\n分担すれば、その分早く終わるだろう
traducao: Say, is there anything I can help with?\nIf we split the work,\nit'll finish that much faster.

original: そんな……いけません！
traducao: Goodness... absolutely not!

original: ガイ様はお客様なんです。\nお客様に雑用なんて、させられません
traducao: You are a guest, Master Guy!\nI cannot let a guest do chores.

original: お客様じゃない。\n俺は使用人なんだよ、ロックス
traducao: I'm not a guest.\nI am a servant, Rocks.

original: でも……
前に言っただろう？\n困った事があったら、力になるってさ。\n水くさい事は言いっこなしだ
traducao: Didn't I tell you before?\nI said I'd help when you're in need.\nDon't treat me like a stranger.

original: ガイ様……
traducao: Master Guy...

original: ほら、そうと決まれば\n早くやる事やっちまおうぜ
traducao: Come on, now that that's settled,\nlet's knock this work out quick!

original: ……はい！
traducao: ...Yes!

original: あの……ガイ様！
traducao: Um... Master Guy!

original: ああ……ロックスか。\nどうしたんだ？
traducao: Oh... Rocks.\nWhat's up?

original: あの……、この間は手伝わせてしまって\n本当にすみませんでした
traducao: Um... I am truly sorry for making you\nhelp me the other day.

original: 結局、すごく遅くまで\n仕事をお任せする事になってしまって……
traducao: In the end, I ended up leaving you\nworking until very late...

original: ああ、なんだその事か
traducao: Oh, is that all it is?

original: そういう日もあるさ。\n気にするな。\n使用人の宿命ってやつだ、心得てるよ
traducao: Some days are like that.\nDon't sweat it. That's a servant's\nlot in life, and I know it well.

original: どうした？
traducao: What's wrong?

original: あ……。\nなんだか……嬉しいんです
traducao: Ah...\nIt just... makes me happy.

original: こんな風に話せる……その、知り合いが\nこれまで、周りにいなかったので……
traducao: I've never had an acquaintance\nI could talk to like this before...

original: 知り合いじゃなくて、仲間だよ。\nこっちとしても優秀な同士が出来て\n心強いくらいだ
traducao: Not an acquaintance, a comrade.\nGaining such an excellent colleague\nis truly reassuring to me too.

original: ガイ様……
traducao: Master Guy...

original: また仕事がキツい時は言ってくれ。\n手が空いていれば、いつでも手伝おう
traducao: Tell me whenever work gets tough.\nIf I'm free, I'll help anytime.

original: ……言っておくが\n変な気遣いや遠慮は無用だからな？
traducao: ...Just so you know, there's no need\nto hold back or hesitate, okay?

original: ……はい！\nありがとうございます
traducao: ...Yes!\nThank you so very much.

original: ふ……、ふぇ……、\nふぇっくしょい！！！
traducao: Ah... ahh...\nAchooooo!!!

original: あ〜、すっきりした……
traducao: Aaah, that feels much better...

original: 掃除は好きだが、ホコリが\n舞い上がるのがなぁ……
traducao: I love cleaning, but having all\nthat dust flying around is rough...

original: 今のくしゃみ、風邪？\n風邪でしょ？
traducao: Was that sneeze a cold?\nYou've got a cold, right?

original: い、いや……その……。\n今のは、そういうのじゃ………
traducao: N-No... um...\nThat wasn't anything like that...

original: わかってるって！\nアーチェさん特製のスペシャル……
traducao: I know, I know!\nMiss Arche's special brew...

original: よ……よ……\n寄らないで……
traducao: D-D-Don't...\ncome near me...

original: 何？　\nどったの？\nそんなに汗かいて
traducao: What?\nWhat's the matter?\nYou're sweating up a storm.

original: あーー！　\nわかった、\n悪寒がすごいんでしょ？
traducao: Aaah!\nI get it! You're shivering\nwith awful chills, right?!

original: だったら、この特製……
traducao: In that case, this special...

original: か……勘弁してくれーーーーー！！！
traducao: G-Gimme a breeeaaaak!!!

original: 何よ、全然元気なんじゃん。\nぶーぶー
traducao: What? You're completely fine then!\nBoo, hiss!

original: しっかし、\nこの船も機能が多彩だなぁ
traducao: Man, this ship really has\na lot of versatile functions.

original: ふふ。\n余程、ここがお気に召したみたいね
traducao: Fufu.\nYou seem to like this place quite a bit.

original: あ……、あー。\n機械とか、そっち系は大好きだからさ
traducao: A-Ah... yeah.\nI love machinery and stuff like that.

original: へぇ〜、機械に目が無くて\n女性には弱いって、割りとウブなのね
traducao: Heh~, crazy for machines and helpless\naround women? Quite innocent, eh?

original: いや、俺だって、女性は好きだ！
traducao: Hey, I like women plenty myself!

original: だけど、よく言うだろ？\n「男は黙ってタルタロ……」
traducao: But like they say, right?\n'A real man stays silent for Tartaros...'

original: あら、何が好きですって？\nよく聞こえなかったわ？
traducao: Oh? What did you say you like?\nI couldn't quite hear you.

original: お……、お、男は……、\nだ、黙って……、タ、タルタロ……
traducao: A-A real man... stays...\ns-silent... for T-Tartaros...

original: タルタロ……？
traducao: Tartaros...?

original: スーーーーーーーーッ！！！
traducao: SSSSSSSS!!!

original: よくわからなかったわ、残念
traducao: I couldn't quite understand. A shame.

original: ジュディスちゃんに、\nあんなに近寄られて、ズルイ……
traducao: Getting so close to Judith-chan...\nNot fair...

original: ぷっぷくぷ〜だ……
traducao: Pout, pout, pooout...

original: 通常。\n
traducao: Normal.\n

original: あめんぼ赤いなアイウエオ\n柿木栗の木カキクケコ\n大角豆に酢をかけサシスセソ
traducao: Red leather, yellow leather, A-E-I-O-U,\nShe sells seashells by the seashore,\nPeter Piper picked pickled peppers.

traducao: Laughter.\n
